::: hero-intro
I am a sociologist and DPhil in Anthropology at the University of Oxford. My work sits at the intersection of science, health, and society, with a parallel interest in social theory, methods, and the philosophy of the social sciences
:::

## Current work

At Oxford, I am developing research on the health implications of energy transitions, including the relationship between new energy activities, water use, infrastructure, and population health. Across projects, I am interested in human flourishing, knowledge, health, and how to best study them

## Beyond research

I also use this site to share reflections, teaching materials, reading, films, and career updates. Comments and conversations are always welcome.

Posts may appear in English or Spanish. Working papers listed on this site are either under review or developed enough to share and discuss
